title: Working Hours Policy
description: Employees must follow the official company working hours.
purpose: To ensure consistent attendance and clear working-hour expectations for all employees.
scope: This policy applies to all employees, contractors, and HR staff.
details: Employees are expected to arrive on time, complete their scheduled working hours, and notify their manager in case of absence or delay.
responsibilities: Employees must follow attendance rules, record working hours correctly, and communicate any delays or absences.

title: Leave Policy
description: Employees must submit leave requests through the HR system.
purpose: To provide a clear and consistent process for requesting and approving employee leave.
scope: This policy applies to all employees eligible for annual, sick, or other approved leave.
details: Employees must submit leave requests in advance through the HR system. Approval is subject to manager and HR review.
responsibilities: Employees are responsible for submitting accurate leave requests and informing their managers before the leave period.

title: Client Confidentiality Policy
description: Employees must protect all confidential client information and project details.
purpose: To protect client privacy and maintain professional trust.
scope: This policy applies to all employees, designers, contractors, and project team members.
details: Client information, floor plans, budgets, addresses, images, and project documents must not be shared outside the company without authorization.
responsibilities: Employees must keep client information secure and report any unauthorized access or disclosure to management.

title: Design Approval Policy
description: All interior design concepts must be approved before implementation begins.
purpose: To ensure that project designs meet client expectations and company quality standards.
scope: This policy applies to designers, project managers, and employees involved in design projects.
details: Design concepts, layouts, materials, colors, furniture selections, and 3D visualizations must receive approval from the client and project manager before execution.
responsibilities: Designers must document approvals and project managers must verify that approved designs are followed during implementation.

title: Site Safety Policy
description: Employees and contractors must follow safety requirements at all project sites.
purpose: To provide a safe working environment and reduce accidents during project execution.
scope: This policy applies to employees, contractors, suppliers, and visitors entering company project sites.
details: Required safety equipment must be used when necessary. Work areas must remain organized and hazardous conditions must be reported immediately.
responsibilities: Project managers must monitor site safety while employees and contractors must follow all safety instructions.

title: Material Selection Policy
description: Project materials must meet approved quality, design, and budget requirements.
purpose: To ensure consistency, durability, and quality across interior design projects.
scope: This policy applies to designers, procurement employees, project managers, and suppliers.
details: Materials including flooring, lighting, fabrics, paint, furniture, and finishes must match approved specifications before purchase or installation.
responsibilities: Designers must define material specifications and procurement staff must verify materials before ordering.

title: Project Change Request Policy
description: Changes to approved project designs must follow a formal approval process.
purpose: To control project changes and prevent unexpected delays or additional costs.
scope: This policy applies to clients, designers, project managers, and employees involved in project execution.
details: Any change to the design, materials, furniture, budget, or project timeline must be documented and approved before implementation.
responsibilities: Project managers must record change requests, calculate their impact, and obtain client approval.

title: Supplier and Vendor Policy
description: Suppliers must meet company standards for quality, reliability, pricing, and delivery.
purpose: To maintain professional relationships with reliable suppliers and protect project quality.
scope: This policy applies to procurement employees, project managers, suppliers, and approved vendors.
details: Suppliers should be evaluated based on product quality, pricing, delivery performance, warranty, and customer service.
responsibilities: Procurement employees must verify supplier information and document supplier performance.

title: Project Documentation Policy
description: All project information must be properly documented and stored.
purpose: To maintain accurate project records and support effective project management.
scope: This policy applies to designers, project managers, HR staff, and employees working on client projects.
details: Project documents should include contracts, floor plans, drawings, approvals, budgets, invoices, material selections, schedules, and client communications.
responsibilities: Project managers must ensure project records are accurate, organized, updated, and securely stored.

title: Quality Control Policy
description: All completed interior design work must meet company quality standards.
purpose: To deliver high-quality projects and maintain client satisfaction.
scope: This policy applies to designers, project managers, contractors, and employees involved in project execution.
details: Installation, furniture, lighting, finishes, painting, and decorative elements must be inspected before final project delivery.
responsibilities: Project managers must perform quality inspections and ensure defects are corrected before client handover.

title: Client Communication Policy
description: Employees must maintain professional and clear communication with clients.
purpose: To ensure clients receive accurate information and regular project updates.
scope: This policy applies to designers, project managers, sales employees, and employees communicating with clients.
details: Clients should receive updates regarding design progress, project schedules, approvals, delays, costs, and significant project changes.
responsibilities: Employees must communicate professionally and project managers must ensure important decisions are documented.

title: Project Budget Policy
description: Project expenses must remain within the approved project budget.
purpose: To control project costs and prevent unauthorized spending.
scope: This policy applies to project managers, designers, procurement employees, and finance staff.
details: Purchases and project expenses must be recorded and compared with the approved budget. Significant additional costs require approval.
responsibilities: Project managers must monitor expenses while finance staff must maintain accurate financial records.

title: Project Deadline Policy
description: Employees must follow approved project schedules and completion deadlines.
purpose: To ensure interior design projects are completed efficiently and delivered on time.
scope: This policy applies to project managers, designers, contractors, and employees assigned to projects.
details: Project milestones and deadlines must be monitored regularly. Any expected delay must be reported and communicated as early as possible.
responsibilities: Project managers must track project progress and employees must report any issues that could affect deadlines.

title: Company Equipment Policy
description: Company equipment and design resources must be used responsibly.
purpose: To protect company property and maintain equipment in good condition.
scope: This policy applies to all employees using company computers, tablets, cameras, measurement tools, software, and other equipment.
details: Company equipment must only be used for authorized business activities and should not be removed or transferred without permission.
responsibilities: Employees must protect assigned equipment and report damage, loss, or technical problems immediately.

title: Design Copyright Policy
description: Company designs, drawings, concepts, and visualizations are protected intellectual property.
purpose: To protect original company design work and prevent unauthorized use.
scope: This policy applies to designers, employees, contractors, clients, and external collaborators.
details: Design concepts, drawings, renders, mood boards, presentations, and other creative materials may not be copied, published, or shared without authorization.
responsibilities: Employees must protect company design assets and report unauthorized copying or distribution.
